scope: Selected sources used for the interface-geometry follow-up, not an exhaustive bibliography. No paper is claimed read cover-to-cover. Hypotheses and compute allocations are unverified.

papers.title: When Language Overwrites Vision: Over-Alignment and Geometric Debiasing in Vision-Language Models
papers.relevance: Over-alignment and PCA debiasing are already studied.

papers.title: The Dominance of Text Space: Unveiling the Asymmetric Nature of Cross-Modal Alignment in Large Language Models
papers.relevance: Projector geometry preservation and spectral filtering are close prior work.

papers.title: Rethinking Model Selection in VLM Through the Lens of Gromov-Wasserstein Distance
papers.relevance: Structural similarity, learnability, and encoder selection already studied with full training.

papers.title: When Is Rank-1 Enough? Geometry-Guided Initialization for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.relevance: Gap-aligned LoRA initialization and layer selection.

papers.title: Understanding and Guiding Layer Placement in Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.relevance: Projected-residual account of adaptation placement is existing work.

papers.title: Distill What the Student Can See: Fisher-Projected On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.relevance: Locally reachable visual-output geometry is existing work.

papers.title: A Comprehensive Information-Decomposition Analysis of Large Vision-Language Models
papers.relevance: Synergy decomposition across models, layers, and training stages.

papers.title: Knowledge Insulating Vision-Language-Action Models: Train Fast, Run Fast, Generalize Better
papers.relevance: Action-expert interference, stop-gradient design, discrete-action backbone supervision.

papers.title: AEGIS: Anchor-Enforced Gradient Isolation for Knowledge-Preserving Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
papers.relevance: Existing spectral mismatch account and geometric gradient protection; claims require critical comparison.

papers.title: Flatness Preserves Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.relevance: Existing training-geometry account of instruction blindness; SAM baseline.

papers.title: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs
papers.relevance: Instruction blindness and counterfactual grounding evaluation already exist.

papers.title: CounterAlign: Counterfactual Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.relevance: Counterfactual instruction training is not a fresh standalone idea.

papers.title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
papers.relevance: Shared/private action representations and semantic anchoring are already proposed.

papers.title: From Recovery to Drop-off: How Action Post-training Reduces a VLM's Late-Layer Depth Decodability
papers.relevance: Action post-training and geometric probe degradation are close territory; no claim of full critical review.

papers.title: Cross-Modal Redundancy and the Geometry of Vision-Language Embeddings
papers.relevance: Shared and unimodal subspaces already characterize modality gaps.

papers.title: Escaping Plato's Cave: JAM for Aligning Independently Trained Vision and Language Models
papers.relevance: Frozen-model alignment does not necessarily require new foundation pretraining.

papers.title: KODA: Contrastive Representation Comparison and Alignment for Vision-Language Foundation Models
papers.relevance: Representation-discrepancy analysis already has dedicated methods.

papers.title: Neural Tangent Kernel: Convergence and Generalization in Neural Networks
papers.relevance: Training-kernel mathematics is background, not a proposed new theorem.
